objectClass.notes: Static single-storey branded retail box, exterior shell only. No interior geometry: glazing is authored as a tinted mostly-opaque pane, not an opening. No moving parts are authored, so one root pivot and zero sockets is the correct contract.

reasoning: Silhouette is a single rectangular prism -- low geometric complexity.
Richness is REPETITION (mullions, cap blocks, quoins, canopy plates, downlights, condensers), not intricate form. Six repetitionSystems collapse ~90 parts into 6 InstancedMesh draw calls.
Occlusion risk is real: rear and right walls are entirely unseen in the single plate.
Action readiness is minimal: static exterior shell, box collider, not breakable.

definitionOfDone: Rendered model matches the reference silhouette, the 8.0 x 4.6 x 7.0 m proportions, the visible component hierarchy and the material response for a real-time browser prop.
All four scene-budget ceilings hold: <=16000 triangles, <=12 draw calls, <=8 materials, <=16 unique geometries.
Zero coincident co-facing surface pairs (check-coplanar clean).
Exactly one root pivot and zero sockets; box collider; no destruction groups.
Every material either declares textureless with named evidence, or argues its texture.

qualityContract.minimumSpecDepthRevision: REVISED DOWN from macro 5 / meso 6 / repetitionSystems 5. Those numbers were written in the pre-spec assessment BEFORE the design was costed against the draw-call ceiling, and they were arithmetically impossible: 5 macro + 6 meso components plus 5 instanced systems is 16 draw calls against a hero2x budget of 12. The revised figures are what the finished design actually is (3 macro, 4 meso, 4 systems = 11 draw calls), and the depth the original numbers were reaching for is delivered instead by MERGING -- the parapet carries 4 boxes, the shopfront framing 8 and the roller shutter 2, each as one component and one submission. Recorded rather than silently relaxed, because a contract edited to match the result it is meant to judge is worth nothing unless the reason is on the record.

pivotInventory.name: root
pivotInventory.justification: The ONLY mechanism this prop has. It is a static exterior shell: nothing opens, turns or swings. The sliding doors and the roller shutter are authored as fixed geometry, so they get no pivot -- a named pivot is a promise that a part turns on that axis, and promising a door slide that the factory does not deliver is contract the kit would have to keep.

actionReadiness.socketJustification: ZERO sockets, deliberately. Nothing attaches to this prop and nothing is emitted from it. A socket named for a place on the surface (sign-mount, socket-top-center) is a location, not a mechanism, and would be contract nobody asked for.

colliderInventory.note: The asset declares collider 'box'. One box proxy over the envelope.

actionReadiness.destructionJustification: The asset declares destructionGroups as an empty list -- this prop is NOT breakable. No component carries actionProfile.destruction.fractureGroup. promote-model checks built against declared as an equality in BOTH directions, so an invented group would fail the gate just as a missing one would.

assumptions: Rear (-Z) and right (+X) elevations are unobserved; authored as plain render walls with no openings. Confidence 0.20 / 0.25.
Canopy downlight count is inferred as one per canopy plate (6). The soffit is seen only at a grazing angle. Confidence 0.50.

All four rooftop condensers are authored from ONE merged casing+cowl geometry instanced 4x. The plate shows two visually similar unit types; collapsing them to one type spends 1 draw call instead of 2 and is a deliberate, reported simplification.
The building is a solid exterior shell. No interior geometry exists, so the glazing is authored as a tinted mostly-opaque pane (opacity 0.92) rather than an opening.

coordinateFrame.notes: Origin base-center as the asset declares. The glazed shopfront faces +Z. The roller shutter is on the -X wall and is NOT mirrored: only one is evidenced in the single plate. The subject is ASYMMETRIC about X; no mirror plane is declared and none may be assumed.

silhouette.description: One rectangular prism. The only silhouette events are the taller front parapet sign wall, the cantilevered entrance canopy and the rooftop condenser cluster breaking the roofline.
silhouette.envelopeDerivation: x spans -4.00..+4.00 (parapet ring outer faces) = 8.00. y spans 0.00..4.60 (ground to cap-block top) = 4.60. z spans -3.50 (rear parapet) ..+3.50 (canopy nose) = 7.00. componentTree.name: Building shell: solid rendered walls
componentTree.topologyRationale: One continuous painted render skin over four walls. Splitting it per elevation would cost a draw call per wall for the life of the prop to express one material.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: Solid box, x -3.94..+3.94, y 0..3.55, z -3.44..+2.50 (7.88 x 3.55 x 5.94 m). SOLID, not a ring: the prop is an exterior shell that is only ever seen from outside, so an interior would cost draw calls, geometries and VRAM for something nobody sees. Solid also means the shopfront needs no opening cut in it, which removes all four reveal faces and the z-fighting they cause.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: Set INSIDE the parapet ring in every horizontal direction (walls at +-3.94 and -3.44; parapet at +-4.00 and -3.50). The 0.06 m difference is a coping drip edge, and it is what stops the wall face and the parapet face being coplanar and co-facing.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: FOUR boxes merged into ONE component and ONE draw call: front sign wall x -4..4, y 2.70..4.50, z 2.20..2.74 -- the WHOLE elevation above the canopy, not a parapet strip. The wall stops at 4.50 so the cap blocks (4.02..4.60) cap it; it overlaps into the shell and the canopy plates. Left and right upstands x +-3.76..+-4.00, y 3.55..3.95, z -3.50..2.20; rear upstand y 3.55..3.95, z -3.50..-3.26.
geometryDescriptor.zFightingNote: The parapet outer faces (+-4.00, -3.50) stand 0.06 m PROUD of the shell walls (+-3.94, -3.44). Authored flush they would have been coplanar and co-facing along all three elevations -- the exact defect that shipped eight times on the 7-Eleven. The front box overlaps into the shell volume rather than butting it.

textureless.note: Declared textureless so createSculptMaterial skips makeProceduralTextureSet entirely. That builds FIVE canvases per material at textureResolution pixel by pixel in JavaScript, at a cost that is the SQUARE of the resolution. It is also a correctness fix: whenever a texture set exists the generator forces color to white and roughness to 1 and reads both from the generated maps, discarding this measured albedo -- which is exactly what renders a building mid-grey.

repetitionSystems.name: Shopfront vertical mullions

placement.note: Five mullions in each glazed run on a 0.338 m pitch, plus the meeting stile at x=0. y 0.12..2.52, under the frame head.

featureReviews.name: Overall silhouette and proportions
featureReviews.evidence: THREE independent measurements agree. (1) Bounding box: 8.00 x 4.60 x 7.00 m built against 8 x 4.6 x 7 declared, exact. (2) Meshy v7 reconstructed the same plate independently and its bounds normalise to 1 : 0.584 : 0.860 against the declared 1 : 0.575 : 0.875 -- within 1.7% on both axes. (3) Area-weighted SURFACE band comparison against that mesh, feet-aligned and height-normalised: mean absolute width delta 0.060 and depth delta 0.112 of height across ten bands.
featureReviews.notes:
Sits exactly at its threshold, and the residual is named rather than smoothed over. Band 9 (the top 10%) is the one real divergence: the reference mesh reports depth 1.080 of height there against this model's 0.908. That band contains only the front cap course in this model, and Meshy smooths the rooftop plant cluster into the parapet ring, which is precisely the hallucination a generative proxy produces at the top of a subject. The PLATE is the authority and the plate shows a tall front sign wall over low side upstands, so this was deliberately NOT chased.
The raw frame-space silhouette IoU is 0.665, but that number is dominated by camera: the harness frames to a fixed radius while the plate is a long-lens near-orthographic shot with the subject at 75% frame height, leaving a 16% scale delta. Aligned bounding boxes and normalised, IoU is 0.826, with aspect ratio matched to 2.1% at azimuth 315 / elevation 20.

That is an approximation and is reported as one. merge static components and reduce local feature geometry

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Real-time browser FPS prop on low-end integrated GPUs; a level builder places hundreds at once. All four ceilings come from thaikit resolveBudget() for the hero2x class and none was invented. The component split was chosen against the DRAW-CALL ceiling in the blockout, before any geometry existed: the parapet ring, the shopfront framing and the roller shutter are merged multi-box components rather than parts to be merged later, and the canopy downlights and condenser cowls are folded into their instanced parent geometry. A pivot hung off a part cannot be merged afterwards, which is why none of this was left to an optimization pass.

drawCalls.note: Four repetition systems collapse 39 discrete parts (18 cap blocks and quoins, 6 canopy plates, 11 mullions, 4 condensers) into 4 InstancedMesh submissions. Authored as components they would have been 39 draw calls against a ceiling of 12.

materials.note: render-wall is shared by the shell AND the parapet ring -- measured at #9B9289 on the wall and #9C938A on the parapet, a one-level difference, so they are one material and not two. galv-plant is shared by the rooftop plant and the roller shutter. The block-to-block tone on the cap course is per-instance COLOUR, not a second material: a colour difference is not a material difference.

uniqueGeometries.note: One per component (7) plus one per repetition system (4). The 7-Eleven sibling records the correction that matters here: a scaled box is NOT a shared geometry, because the generator bakes real dimensions in via geometry.scale(), so every differently-sized box is genuinely distinct. Each InstancedMesh does reuse a single geometry across all its instances, which is the whole point, so the four systems add four and not thirty-nine.

triangles.note: Triangles are NOT the binding constraint on this prop -- draw calls are, at 11 of 12. The large triangle headroom is deliberately spent on silhouette quality (the 0.012 m chamfer on every box, the 16-segment condenser cowls, the 20-rib shutter profile) and must NOT be read as room to split components, which would spend the axis that is actually scarce.

High fill ratio inferred from the shadow-side wall retaining full value. This is WHY the measured crop means are usable as albedo with almost no key to subtract.
The seamless backdrop acts as a large uniform environment. Drives the satin lobe on the aluminium and the specular on the glazing; envMapIntensity is set per material against it.
NO rim light is present in the plate. Recorded explicitly so the review does not read a missing rim in the render as a defect.

Exposure 1.0 with ACES filmic tone mapping. The backdrop measures 132 against a nominal #808080 (128), so the plate is within 3% of neutral exposure -- no exposure compensation is applied to the measured albedos, and none is warranted.

NO contact shadow and NO ground shadow in the plate: the reference prompt asked for a cut-out floating against a seamless backdrop with nothing underneath, and the plate delivers that -- the border ring measures uniform with no darkening under the building. Recorded explicitly so the absence is not read as a missing feature. IN USE the prop is a floor-placed building and the HOST scene owns its contact shadow: the factory ships castShadow enabled on every mesh and receiveShadow on the roof deck and canopy, and defines no ground plane of its own.

proceduralStrategy.strategy: box, cylinder and merged-box clusters only. No organic surfaces exist on this subject.
Four InstancedMesh systems carry 39 of the 50 discrete parts.
All procedural variation (cap-block tone, condenser yaw) is assigned by instance INDEX, not by a random source, so the model is byte-identical on every build.

Six of seven materials are declared textureless. The seventh, sign-face, is also declared textureless and receives the Big C wordmark as a generated canvas assigned AFTER material construction -- the documented route for a printed brand fascia, unaffected by the declaration.
